Indian pilot averts mid-air incident on Flydubai flight

An Indian pilot, Smit Machchhar, is being hailed as a hero after averting a mid-air incident on a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30. The co-pilot allegedly attacked Machchhar, leading to a rapid descent of the aircraft to land safely in Tabuk. Flight-tracking data indicated the aircraft transmitted a general emergency code. The incident involved 174 passengers and crew. The United Arab Emirates has launched a criminal investigation into the incident, examining potential links to terrorist activity or intent. The co-pilot's actions have been described as a possible terrorist act, with one report suggesting it was an attempt at a deliberate crash. Machchhar sustained injuries during the incident but is recovering well, according to the Indian envoy to the UAE. Passengers were reportedly able to subdue the attacker after Machchhar opened the cockpit door.
